title: How often should the cold room repair and maintenance activity take place?
desc: It is recommended that the cold room should be periodically maintained at least once annually. Depending on its nature of working, cold room repair and maintenance should be done immediately if required.

title: Should I try to diagnose and fix cold room issues myself?
desc: You can always diagnose a problem but in order to solve a complex issue, always engage professional technicians. This will reduce any chances of further damage and electrocution.

title: I am unaware of any cold room repair near me, who should I call?
desc: Don't worry. You can always call FAJ services on the helpline and our professionally trained technicians will take care of all your walk in cold room and freezer room repairs.

title: Should I hire someone to check my cold room periodically?
desc: YES. It is highly recommended to hire professionals on a periodic basis for such activities .

title: How do I know if my freezer is not working properly?
desc: The best way to know if you require a freezer repair & maintenance is by observing the difference in desired and actual temperature of the cold room unit.

title: What types of cold rooms can our technicians check and repair?
desc: Cold room chiller units, cold room freezer, walk in cold room, walk in freezer room, cold room hospital, cold room restaurant, ambient cold room, blast chiller, industrial cold rooms, medical cold room, modular cold rooms and many other makes / models.
